title: Environment
description: Human-approved desired state for one environment: which release, on which target. Promotion is a one-line diff of spec.release.

release.$comment: canonical repo-root-relative path resolving only within .deploy/releases/; enforced further by semantic checks (no traversal, flat lowercase file name)

autoRollback.$comment: off: never roll back automatically. safe-only: automatic rollback only when the failed release's migration.rollbackSafe is true. Emergency/manual recovery is a separate explicit authority path and is deliberately not overloaded into this policy.
